Marvell Shares Fall Amidst Mixed Financial Performance and Outlook Concerns

Marvell Technology shares experienced an 8% decline following the release of its financial results. While the company reported a 37% revenue growth, its future outlook reportedly underwhelmed investors. Concerns were also raised regarding the timing of revenue recognition from a Google AI deal, which overshadowed strong quarterly performance.
